class: Background posting action selected behind active dialog
symptom: After the owner completed CAPTCHA, the agent clicked the covered posting Apply button and timed out.
root_cause: The whole-body accessibility snapshot included both the entry dialog and background posting; deterministic forward priority chose Apply before the dialog Continue.
why_tests_missed: Entry-form tests lacked a simultaneously visible background Apply button after a human challenge disappeared.
fix: Read the last visible dialog as the active interaction scope, returning to body only after it closes.
prevention: Verify the actual continuation action and resulting dialog transition, not just challenge disappearance.
